decision.scopeOfAccept: ACCEPT of doctor-fc-degraded-input-corpus.v1 as a DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no express reservation. The artifact remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and carries DO-NOT-SEAL on its own terms. decision.summaryForCoordinator: Two prohibitions here needed real probes rather than token counts, and both hold. The timestamp prohibition is the sharper one, because DEG-6's image is a clock 'skewed forward and backward ... with recorded revocation and expiry timestamps pinned' and DEG-4's is an artifact in the recorded revocation state — both invite a concrete time value. I probed every timestamp shape: ISO datetime with T, ten-digit unix epoch, epoch milliseconds, HH:MM:SS clock time, Z suffix — all NONE. Exactly one date-shaped string exists in the file and it is the artifact's own top-level date, attached to no state. The bare-integer set across the whole file is 0, 1, 26, so there is no skew magnitude, offset, duration or age either. The lock prohibition needed the opposite kind of care: 'lock' occurs 25 times, which looks alarming until you notice DEG-2 and DEG-3 are ABOUT the project lock as a document. Classified by sense, 24 are lock-as-noun and exactly ONE is acquisition-sense — the negation 'Does not acquire a lease, refcount, or lock.' All eight lease/refcount/acquire occurrences are negations or the leaseOrLockAcquired field, whose sole value is false on DEG-7. The inventory reconstructs exactly: thirteen states with a degradedCase Counter of 1, 3, 1, 1, 4, 2, 1 — v4's own image multiplicities summed, not a product. I pressed both sub-splits. The DEG-5 four-way ladder is right because v4's 'each position of the prepare/commit/abort ladder including the post-crash ambiguous case' names three positions and adds the fourth by 'including', and the DEG-6 two-way split is just v4's conjunction separated into its limbs. The cartesian attack dies at the token level: 'consent' occurs zero times and no state carries a consent field, so there is no second axis to multiply. One structural choice deserves your attention as a strength. This is the first corpus in the series to carry no verbatimFromV4 field at all, using imageNamed throughout. That is what makes it safe: five of the thirteen images necessarily had to be derived, because v4 states the ladder positions and skew directions collectively, and labelling those 'verbatim' would have been exactly the false claim I flagged in the FC-RO sibling. I tested all thirteen for substring containment anyway — eight verbatim, five derived, every derivation the minimal faithful expansion of its phrase — and the full exactByteIntent is carried by == equality one level up, so each derivation stays checkable without any of them being overclaimed. Custody is clean: subject unmoved at 4864760c and 0444 at both samplings, five of five cited digests equal live bytes, both cited standings confirmed at Claude ACCEPT 0/0 with no Codex verdict, the D-164 join confirms OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING still leftoverDesign true with owner none and FC-DEGRADED inside its twelve, HEAD 5d5d778, required-now 26, thirty gate rows, no control bytes, and SATISFIED and QUALIFIED occur zero times. I also checked the two thirteens are unrelated — the join's thirteen FC-JOIN classes and this corpus's thirteen states coincide numerically and both verify independently. Twenty-one attacks run, twenty-one refuted, zero findings. Like FC-POSTREPORT, this artifact has no annotation that time can falsify: the g12v2 role makes no recency claim and the fcRoV1 role makes only a structural claim. The nits are two: no evidence member is named, though live G12 v2 supplies FC-DEGRADED at EV-7 'idempotence' alongside the very FC-RO sibling this corpus cites; and this is the first GATE-DERIVED class in the series, which the subject does not mention either way, so a reader carrying assumptions from the source-pin-derived corpora gets no signal that FC-DEGRADED's authority runs through DR-G12's harness column rather than file 04.
